results.description: Send an appointment request to DOCVY for your chosen doctor and hospital. DOCVY records your preferences. The provider must confirm availability and fees.
Learn what common medical specialties do, from skin and hair to bones and joints, and what to bring to a first appointment.
Bariatric teams discuss weight-management options and whether surgery is appropriate after an individual assessment.
Cardiologists focus on the heart and circulation. The clinic can tell you whether to start with a general physician or a heart specialist.
Critical care specialists care for people with serious illness in a hospital’s intensive care unit. This directory is not an emergency service.
Dentists assess concerns involving the teeth, gums and mouth and discuss options for care.
Dermatologists see people with concerns involving the skin, scalp, hair and nails.
Endocrinologists assess hormone-related conditions, including thyroid disorders and diabetes.
ENT specialists assess concerns involving hearing, the nose, and the throat.
Gastroenterologists assess concerns involving digestion, the stomach, bowel and liver.
A general physician can review several concerns together and help you plan a next step.
Gynaecologists focus on reproductive health. Ask the clinic which services are available at your chosen location.
Hepatologists care for people with liver conditions, including hepatitis and fatty liver disease.
Mental health services may include psychiatrists and clinical psychologists. Ask the clinic which service is right for your first conversation.
Laparoscopic surgeons use small-incision techniques for selected procedures. Suitability depends on your condition and assessment.
Nephrologists assess kidney function, chronic kidney disease and concerns related to dialysis.
Neurologists assess concerns involving the brain, nerves and nervous system.
Oncology teams assess and treat cancer. The relevant specialty may be medical, surgical or radiation oncology, depending on your referral.
Ophthalmologists assess eye health and discuss options for eye conditions.
Orthopaedic specialists look after problems involving bones, joints and movement, including injuries.
Paediatricians care for infants, children and adolescents.
Plastic surgeons discuss reconstructive and cosmetic care, including treatment goals, alternatives and recovery.
Proctology services assess concerns involving the anus and rectum, including piles, fissures and fistulas.
Pulmonologists assess breathing difficulties, persistent cough and conditions affecting the lungs.
Urologists assess urinary tract concerns and discuss treatment options for kidney stones and related conditions.
Vascular surgeons assess blood-vessel conditions, including circulation problems and varicose veins.
Follow up on your DOCVY appointment request using your reference and selected clinic.
